title: Mercury stand-in art
description: Nine calm, frosted picture fills: misty hills at dawn, a blurred sunlit room, overlapping glass circles, a light rising from a glowing horizon, a line globe in paper rings, a dish of rings with a typing indicator, two coverage bars (one lit), a frosted fingerprint, and three soft switches.
notes: fills its parent: give it a sized, rounded box
stands in for photography and product video; swap for real images when you have them
paper and mist panels use chart-5 and chart-3, so they pick up colour in themes with saturated chart colours
